title: goniopteris crypta
intro: Goniopteris crypta, commonly known as the Crypt fern, is a species of fern in the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used in various cultures for its health benefits. The Crypt fern is said to have anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions in treating various health conditions.
